title: Historical HAZOP — instrument/plant air compression station (2019)

chunks.text: Air compressor discharge blocked by inadvertently closed manual valve during standby swap; interstage pressure rose to relief set point and the PSV lifted. Recommendation: car-seal open discharge block valves, add discharge pressure high alarm.

Loss of cooling water to the aftercooler caused high compressor discharge temperature and trip; repeated events traced to fouled cooler tubes. Consequence: hot air to downstream dryer, desiccant damage. Safeguard: discharge temperature high alarm and trip TAH/TSH.

Air receiver overpressure scenario: pressure controller failure combined with low plant air demand. Receiver protected by spring-loaded PSV sized for full compressor capacity. Verify PSV set pressure does not exceed vessel design pressure.

Failure to switch dryer towers on schedule led to moisture carryover into the instrument air header; multiple control valves hunting. Cause: dryer sequence controller fault. Safeguard: dew point analyzer with alarm on dryer outlet.

Total loss of instrument air (no flow in IA header) on simultaneous trip of running and standby compressors during power dip; air receivers provided approximately 8 minutes holdup for safe shutdown. Consequence: plant-wide fail-safe valve action.
